content: PostgreSQL SET docs: values for SET are string constants, identifiers, numbers or lists thereof - the command does NOT accept bind parameters. SET LOCAL outside a transaction block emits a warning and has no effect. Therefore SET LOCAL app.workspace_id = :ws cannot be parameterised through asyncpg/SQLAlchemy; the correct parameterised form is SELECT set_config('app.workspace_id', :ws, true) inside an open transaction.
